paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Milim Biakna Mohpaihna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel tang lam nga inla, akiang uah thu gen inla,

Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN in tangte leh mualte kiang ah, leh phaizangte leh kuamte kiang ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in na tung uah namsau ka hon lik ding a, na mun sangte uh ka hihse vek ding.
Na maitamte uh loihsan in a-om ding a, na ni pathian limte uh akitamzan ding; na mithah luangte uh na milimte uh ma ah ka pai ding hi.
Amilimte uh ma ah Israel suante luang ka koihkhawm ding a, na guhte uh na maitam kim uah ka thehzak ding hi.

Na tenna mun tengteng uah khopi ase ding a, mun sangte akisegawp ding; na maitamte uh hihsiat leh loihsan ahihtheihna ding un leh na milimte uh akitapnen a, aman theihna ding in leh na ni pathian limte uh phukpaih a a-omtheihna ding un, na nasepte uh aman theihna ding in.
Huan na lak uah mithahte apuk ding ua, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Himahleh gam chih a na dalhzak hun chiang un namte lak ah namsau a suakta a-om ding ziak un akhen ka hon hawi ding.

Huan na lak ua kipan a pawtte'n sal a apina namte uh lak ah kei ahon theigige ding ua, a-angkawmna lungtang uh ka lakmang sakleh amit uh, amilim lam ua angkawmte ka hihsiat sakdante athei ding uh; thil gilou a na hih ziak uleh akihhuai ziak un amau mitmuh ngei in leng kihhuai akisa ding uh.
Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding ua, hiai thil hoih lou akiang uah ka hih ding a, amawk in ka chi kei chih athei ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na khut beng in na khe pek inla, Maizen! Israel inkote kihhuaina gitlouh ziak maw! Namsau in, kial in, hipi in apuk ding uhi.
Gamlapi a om hipi in asi ding ua, anai a om namsau in apuk ding ua, aval, um a omte kial in asi ding uh; hichibang in ka hehna mahmah atung uah ka bukimsak ding hi.

Mual sang teng ah, tang vumte ah leh sing hing peuhmah nuai ah leh tosaw bawkpha chih nuai a amilimte uh kiang a gimlim alatna mun ua amaitam kim ua amilimte uh lak a amisi luangte uh a-om hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a, gamdai a kipan Diblah lam a atenna mun tengteng uh gamsia suaksak in ka loihsan vek ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
